rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rusty IMAP is a Rust-based MCP server for IMAP email access, built with security as a first-class concern. It sanitizes email content against prompt-injection attacks using HTML sanitization, Unicode normalization, and look-alike detection before presenting content to AI agents. The server provides 24 tools across posture-gated email operations with four authorization levels, append-only audit logging, rate limiting, and TLS certificate pinning for multi-account support.
